title: Indian epic Ramayana passes $100 million at the worldwide box office
summary: The film has also been showing in cinemas across the United States.
body:
Ramayana: Rise of a Legend, the big-budget Indian film based on the ancient Hindu epic, has taken more than $100 million at cinemas worldwide, according to trade reports.

Deadline reports that the total has been driven mainly by audiences in India. Other trade outlets say it is the first international film from outside China to reach that figure this year.

In the United States

The film took an estimated $12 million in North America on its opening weekend, according to Box Office Worldwide.

It stars Ranbir Kapoor as Rama and Sai Pallavi as Sita.

Box office figures are estimates and differ slightly between sources. Sources: Deadline, Variety India.
